### CVE-2004-2154
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2005-07-05 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: n/a; CWE-178 CWE-178 Improper Handling of Case Sensitivity
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

CUPS before 1.1.21rc1 treats a Location directive in cupsd.conf as case sensitive, which allows attackers to bypass intended ACLs via a printer name containing uppercase or lowercase letters that are different from what is specified in the directive.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
- apple / cups: affected 0 <1.1.21 (custom)
- canonical / ubuntu_linux: affected 4.10
